ns2:course.label: Acting Studio I: Acting
ns2:course.description: Acting in realistic and naturalistic plays. A performance is given at the end of the term. Enrollment limited to Theatre majors. Prerequisite: THEA 275, consent of chair of Acting Program, and concurrent registration in THEA 371, THEA 372, and THEA 373.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: THEA 275, consent of chair of Acting Program, and concurrent registration in THEA 371, THEA 372, and THEA 373.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Acting Majors only. Sophomore level and above.
